title: Planet Labs PBC Q1 fiscal 2027 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At April 30, 2026, Planet reported substantial cash and short-term investments, $460 million face-value convertible notes, material unvested equity awards, and continuing satellite and software investment.
summary: The unchanged filing supplies the latest balance sheet, share count, dilution, cash-runway, cash-burn and operating-economics inputs for the scenario-complete pre-profit growth valuation.
